name: schemastud
description: The @schemastud JS package family — a single npm workspace. Packages stay at their existing top-level paths so the fleet's file: overlays and the live FC/RCP wiring keep resolving unchanged.
//workspaces: Listed in TOPOLOGICAL order (leaves first) so `npm run build --workspaces` builds each package after the @schemastud deps whose .d.ts it needs: seam/facets (leaves) -> blockdoc/frame-remote/frame -> chat. If the graph outgrows a hand-ordered list, adopt a graph-aware runner (Turborepo/Nx) rather than maintaining this by hand. (beam-mdx lives in the separate `beam` app-substrate monorepo — same @schemastud npm scope.)
